dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Hey Sholpan! What are you doing right now?

dialogue.speaker: Sholpan
dialogue.text: I'm eating lunch in the cafeteria. Why? What's happening?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Are you working on the project? The deadline is tomorrow!

dialogue.speaker: Sholpan
dialogue.text: Not right now. I'm starving! Are you in the library?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm writing the code for our program. Where is Dastan?

dialogue.speaker: Sholpan
dialogue.text: He's playing football outside with the sports club. Again.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Again?! He's always playing football! What are you eating?

dialogue.speaker: Sholpan
dialogue.text: Soup and bread. The soup is really good today — chicken with vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: OK. Are you coming to the library after lunch?

dialogue.speaker: Sholpan
dialogue.text: Yes! I'm finishing my food right now. Give me twenty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Great. I'm saving a seat for you. Please hurry — I need help with the loop.

dialogue.speaker: Sholpan
dialogue.text: I'm coming! Stop panicking, Amir. The code isn't running away!

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Ha! OK, see you soon. And tell Dastan to come too!

dialogue.speaker: Sholpan
dialogue.text: I'm texting him right now. But I'm not promising anything.
